title: ever BRYM|Glittery Empire Waist Long Lantern Sleeves A-Line Evening Dress
descriptionHtml:
Elevate your style to new heights with our Glittery Empire Waist Long Lantern Sleeves A-Line Evening Dress. The combination of its empire waist, lantern sleeves, and A-line silhouette creates a flattering and feminine look that's sure to turn heads. Whether you're going to a lavish wedding or a fancy cocktail party, this dress will make you feel like royalty, making it a truly versatile and stunning choice for any special event.


Fit: Please refer to size chart.


Length: Floor length.


Sleeve Style: Long sleeves.


Closure:?Back zipper.


Undergarments: It is padded, with lining.


Fabric:The garment comprises sequin.


Stretch: Fabric is low stretch.
